name: Universidad Nacional del Altiplano Puno data center
developer: Universidad Nacional del Altiplano Puno / Huawei
notes: DCD reported in 2016 that UNA Puno's 15-story academic complex would house a data center; local reporting in 2022 said the data center was installed in the city-university building; 2025 reporting says UNA installed advanced data centers and an automated data center tied to Huawei-backed campus network modernization. Capacity not disclosed.

name: IPTP Networks Desaguadero Data Center
notes: Aggregator listings identify an IPTP Networks Desaguadero data center in Desaguadero, Puno, Peru and colocation/enterprise data center services. No official operator page or capacity found in this pass.

name: ON Empresas Data Center Del Sur / Disaster Recovery Tacna
notes: ON Empresas' own timeline says it inaugurated the Data Center Disaster Recovery in Tacna in 2019; EPI lists ON Empresas Data Center Del Sur at Panamericana Sur km 1308, Tacna with ANSI/TIA-942-C Facility Rated 3 and DCOS certifications; trade sources describe WIN/ON's Tacna facility as a backup/data center near the Chile border. Capacity not disclosed.

name: ON Empresas Disaster Recovery Tacna expansion
notes: Canal TI reported ON Empresas' infrastructure plan included expansion of the Disaster Recovery data center in Tacna, alongside La Molina and regional data center investments. Capacity and schedule not disclosed.
